about:
Vital Plastics, LLC was founded in 1994 in Baldwin, Wisconsin, where it operates two manufacturing facilities east of the Twin Cities metro area along Interstate 94. The company is a custom plastic injection molding and assembly solutions provider.

The company runs over 56 all-electric injection molding presses ranging from 30 to 400 tons within 70,000 square feet of climate-controlled space. A cellular manufacturing model and RJG scientific molding practices underpin production, supported by IQMS integration for real-time process data. Beyond molding, Vital Plastics offers a full suite of assembly services—automated, semi-automated, and hand-set—including heat staking, ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, pad printing, and kitting. Tooling maintenance, design, modifications, and warehousing round out the operation. The firm reports a 99.86% on-time delivery rate and has shipped more than 700 million assembled components with a 0.004% defect rate.

Vital Plastics serves Fortune 1000 companies and applies engineering expertise across multiple industries, supporting projects from prototype through high-volume production. Its capabilities include insert molding, overmolding, two-shot molding, and processing of engineered, commodity, filled, unfilled, and high-temperature exotic resins.

The company’s stated mission is to make the “Vital Difference” by centering customers, community, and employees. Its vision emphasizes innovation, sustainable practices, and empowering teams, while core values highlight integrity, respect, teamwork, customer focus, persistence, and innovation. Vital Plastics also positions itself as a domestic reshoring alternative to offshore production.
